translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: ROMANOS
book.title: An u axi thuchanchat an ebchalabchic ti Roma c’al an t’ocat abathuale Pablo

content: Ebchalabchic, nan c’al patal u canat u lej conchal a Dios abal quin jec’ontha’ an Israelchic c’al in hualab.
U tso’obits abal lej c’a’inchix jaja’chic c’al a Dios, expith yab in exlal jant’ini’ ca jec’onthachic.
Yab in exlalchic jant’ini’ ta ca tsu’tat ti bolith c’al a Dios. In lej lubalchic ca tsu’tat ti bolith jant’inits jaja’ in cuete’ tsalap ani yab jant’ini’ in tsalap a Dios.
Tocat quim bela’chic a Cristo ani ne’ets ca tsu’tat ti bolith c’al a Dios. Yabats in yejenchal quin ayna’ an ts’ejcath cau binath c’al a Moisés abal ca tsu’tat ti bolith.
A Moisés in thucha’ max jitats quin tala’ putu c’al jahua’ in ulal an ts’ejcath cau, jats axi ne’ets ca c’uajiy c’al a Dios max anac. Tam ne’ets ca tsu’tat ti bolith c’al a Dios.
Huahua’ ax u tsu’tatits tu bolith c’al a Dios cum i belal a Cristo yab i ulu antsana’. I ulal abal ni jita’ yab in yejenchal ca c’athiy ti eb quin ucha’ a Cristo ca pa’iy tsabal.
Ni jita’ yab in yejenchal ca pa’iy alal jun ti c’uajat in ejattal an tsemelomchic quin ucha’ a Cristo ca c’athiy tsabal yabats ca c’uajiy c’al an tsemelomchic.

I ulal abal pa’iyits teje’ tsabal a Cristo ani calnequits ejthach jun ti jolnenec. Jats an alhua’ cau ax it ejtohuab quit olchinchic ani quit t’aychinchic ta ichich. Jats an alhua’ cau axi huahua’ tu olchinchalchic ani ca lej bela’.
Jats ca bela’ ta lej ichich abal a Dios in ejthamalits jun ti jolnenec, ani ca olna’ abal a Jesús ja’its an Ajatic. Tam ojni’ a Dios ne’ets ti lej jec’ontha’chic c’al a hualab.
Jitats antsana’ quim bela’ tin lej ichich, ja’its axi ne’ets ca tsu’tat ti bolith c’al a Dios. Jitats quin olna’ abal a Jesús ja’its an Ajatic, ja’its axi ne’ets ca jec’ontha c’al in hualab.
In ulal an T’ocat Thuchlab abal jitats quim bela’ a Cristo yab ne’ets ca tithebe ti belom.
A Dios yab im poc’oth tsu’tal an Israelchic ani axi yab Israel. Cum pel i Ajatic c’al patal an inicchic in lej lablinchal jitats c’al ta ca palenchat.
Antsana’ ti thuchathits abal patal jitats quim palenchi im bij an Ajatic ne’ets ca jec’ontha.
Biyat yabaye im belamalchic yab ne’ets quim palenchi, ani yab ne’ets quim bela’ max yab ca olchinchatchic im bij an Ajatic. Ani yab ne’ets ca olchinchatchic max yab hua’ats i olchinchix.

Ani ni jita’ yab in ejtohual ti olchinchix max yab ca abatna c’al a Dios. An T’ocat Thuchlab in olnal axi olchinchix antse’: Lej alabel in xe’tsintal jitats xe’ets ti olchinchix c’al an alhua’ cau c’al ca jun ejetbethanchat in ichich an inicchic c’al a Dios.
Yab patal an inicchic axi ca olchinchat an alhua’ cau ne’ets quim bina’ in xutsun quin ats’a’. Antsana’ in tsalpay a Isaías tam in conoy a Dios jita’ ne’ets quim belchi in cahuintal.
An inicchic quin ats’a’ an alhua’ cau ani tam ne’ets quin ejtou quim belchi. Quin ats’anchi jahua’ ca olnanchat tin cuenta a Cristo.
Auxe’ max an inicchic yab in ats’amal an alhua’ cau. Jal i in ats’amalits jant’ini’ tin ulal an T’ocat Thuchlab antse’:

content.text: A Dios in aba’ i olchinchixchic tim puhuel an tsabal quin olchinchi an inicchic in cahuintal. Ulthanchatits in cahuintal ma ju’tamits hua’ats i inic.

content: Hualam max an Israelchic yab in lej t’ajchi ti cuenta in cahuintal a Dios antse’. Moisés in thucha’ jahua’ in ulu a Dios:

content.text: Ne’ets cu t’aja’ abal tata’ an Israelchic ca pa’ixna’ i bichou axi yab pel u c’al.
Ne’ets quit tsacuychic tam nan cu tolmiy am bichou axi yab tin ejtinchal u cahuintal.

content: C’al i lej inictalab a Isaías in olna’ jahua’ in ulu a Dios antse’:

content.text: Tin ela’ i inicchic axi yab tin aliyamal.
U tejhua’metha’ tu ba’ c’al axi yab in luba’chic tiquin exla’.

content: A Isaías in olna’ jahua’ in ulu a Dios tin cuenta an Israelchic antse’: Patal a q’uicha u canimichicamalits abal ca chich c’al nana’, ani pel i bichou axi lej jec’om ani t’ujbabath in ichich.
